kurz: Grains are mainly starch. Whether rice turns fluffy or creamy depends on how much starch is released.
bild_im_kopf: Like beads in paste: if the paste stays on the beads, they stick; if it is dissolved, it turns creamy.
was_passiert: When cooking, the starch in the grain swells. Starch on the surface dissolves into the water and makes things sticky or creamy. Long-grain rice has starch that tends to stay fluffy; risotto rice releases a lot of starch.
warum_wichtig: For fluffy rice you rinse off starch; for risotto you deliberately stir it out.
faustregeln: For fluffy rice, rinse until the water runs clear.
For fried rice, use rice from the day before.
